purpose: consequence-side cohort-size stability battery (FIT/EVAL two-stage); development window only; final-test reads forbidden
n_grid_upper_bound_rule: 4096 is NEVER auto-judged stable; if any binding metric fails at 2048-vs-4096, status = N_GRID_UPPER_BOUND_REACHED and 8192 extension requires human confirmation

FIT_SIZE_STABILITY.varies: M1_N trained on the N-prefix of the year's hash-ranked TRAIN cohort; calibrated on the N/2-prefix of Y-07
FIT_SIZE_STABILITY.fixed: the same top-4096 development evaluation cases for every N; identical M2 reference bundle for every N

bootstrap.method: all M1_N models are evaluated on the identical fixed development cases; per-replicate resampling is over episodes (grouped, seed below); Metric_N and Metric_4096 are computed within the same replicate on the same resampled cases; Delta_N = Metric_N - Metric_4096 per replicate

EVAL_SIZE_STABILITY.varies: development cohort = nested hash-ranked prefix of size N (same M1_4096 model, same M2 bundle)
EVAL_SIZE_STABILITY.fixed: the M1_4096 model and M2 reference bundle

bootstrap.method: D_N is a hash-ranked nested prefix of D_4096; each bootstrap replicate preserves the prefix dependence: the replicate draws an episode subset R (episode-level, grouped) and evaluates Metric on (D_N intersect R) and (D_4096 intersect R) within the same replicate; Delta_N = Metric_N(R) - Metric_4096(R) per replicate. Plain paired bootstrap over different sample sizes is NOT used.

practical_equivalence_bands.note: 95% CI of Delta_N must fall entirely inside the band; bands frozen before any metric computation

scale_normalization.scale_source: TRAIN / Y-H1-side information only; never development results
scale_normalization.note: the 'value' entries above are the protocol-level floors from the 2019 frozen train scales; the battery recomputes year_train_scale_median per year from the year's Y-H1 rows and uses max(floor, year_median) at runtime, recording both

identifiability_gate.rule: if the denominator event count < min_event_count: status = NOT_IDENTIFIABLE_AT_THIS_N; NOT_IDENTIFIABLE never counts as stability PASS; zero denominator never auto-sets rate to 0

compute_fallback_ladder.note: selected ONLY on runtime/memory probe results before any consequence metric is computed; never outcome-aware
compute_fallback_ladder.probe: time the per-node scenario+consequence cost on the first 128 dev nodes; choose the largest ladder step whose projected wall time fits the pre-registered budget of 6 hours per (year, fixed-dev evaluation)
compute_fallback_ladder.protocol_hash_freeze: the protocol hash is frozen before any scientific metric computation; ladder selection is recorded in the run manifest

windows.t100: YEAR == Y and MONTH <= 6 (annual file is storage granularity, not admissibility granularity)

m2_reference_fixity.bundle_hash_identity_check: required across all N before metrics

m1_determinism_sentinel.protocol: retrain twice with identical seed/data/config; compare training-example hash, normalization hash, calibration hash, checkpoint logits, development metrics

floor_rule.detection: per sentinel setting (year, N): compare the two replica digests (examples, normalization, calibration, state_dict); any digest mismatch sets nondeterminism_detected for that setting
floor_rule.quantification: evaluate both replica checkpoints of every sentinel setting on the SAME fixed development case set (top evaluation_E episodes, with evaluation_E chosen by the compute_fallback_ladder probe) and compute every binding metric value per replica; TRAINING_NONDETERMINISM_FLOOR_m = max over settings of |metric_m(replica_1) - metric_m(replica_2)|
floor_rule.decision: stop with BLOCK_M5B_NONDETERMINISM iff any binding metric has floor_m >= floor_fraction * half_width(band_m); otherwise record all floors and proceed to FIT/EVAL
floor_rule.scope: floor metrics are diagnostic only; they are computed before any FIT/EVAL stability metric and are never stability results

m1_determinism_sentinel.floor_rule_v1_text: if nondeterminism is detected, quantify TRAINING_NONDETERMINISM_FLOOR; if the floor is the same order as any practical-equivalence band, the stability battery is stopped until training determinism is addressed

sanity_checks: practical-equivalence bands neither trivially tight nor trivially loose
FIT and EVAL stability are distinguishable
M2 bundle hash-identical across all N
pilot.epsilon_amendment_rule: no epsilon may be tuned from pilot results; if a band must change, the pilot decision status is voided, the protocol version is bumped, and all six years rerun under the new version

hard_stops: no Oct-Dec (final-test) reads at any point
no COMMON_N_STAR freeze in this stage
no other years beyond the pilot until human review

v2_lineage.change_scope: m1_determinism_sentinel.floor_rule operationalization only; bands, seed, N grid, and fallback ladder are unchanged
